retrievalProfile.description: A structured mid-century layout featuring a central framed typographic block above a seated musician portrait against a clean off-white background.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with framed text
musician with acoustic guitar on stool
olive green and black retro palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A white square composition dominated by a large, gold-bordered rectangular frame containing tiered typography in olive green and black, with a cut-out photograph of a smiling man playing an acoustic guitar seated in the lower left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The typographic frame acts as a header that anchors the top two-thirds of the space.
The musician's head overlaps the bottom edge of the decorative frame, creating depth.
Horizontal rules within the frame separate different levels of text hierarchy.
The olive green of the primary text is echoed in the musician's jacket and the bottom-right logo.
coreInvariants: Double-lined gold border with notched corners framing the main text block.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is positioned in the lower left, scaled to occupy roughly one-third of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold slab-serif text in the upper half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down through the text hierarchy, ending at the musician and then the technical metadata in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space surrounds the musician and the frame, typical of early 1960s design.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones with low saturation and high value in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and light high-contrast serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses ultra-bold slab serifs with square terminals.
Secondary text uses light-weight, high-contrast transitional serifs.
Tertiary metadata uses clean, geometric sans-serifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between heavy slab serifs and delicate transitional serifs.
graphicDevices: Double-line horizontal rules with vertical end-caps

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif display weight.
Matches the high-contrast light serif for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an off-white textured background with a gold notched-corner frame in the top two-thirds. In the lower left, place a cut-out photo of a man in a 1960s varsity jacket playing an acoustic guitar while seated on a wooden stool.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text within the frame using a heavy olive green slab serif for the main title and a light black serif for the secondary text, separated by horizontal rules.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text in a heavy olive green slab serif?
Is the musician positioned in the lower left overlapping the frame?
Are there horizontal rules with end-caps between text lines?
Is the background a clean, slightly textured off-white?

adjustableVariables: Color of the slab serif text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold frame has notched corners.
Verify the slab serif text is significantly heavier than the serif text.
Check that the musician's head slightly overlaps the frame border.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a 1960s vinyl record sleeve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large, framed typographic header with a smaller, isolated subject portrait in the lower quadrant for a classic mid-century editorial look.
